editorialSelections.scope: Source choice and pair comparison only; not effective publication, semantic mapping or activation approval.

privateRevisionProcessing.blocker: Authenticated MCP access returns serialized tool results. No protected in-memory handoff to the Node compiler is available here without placing the private payload in tool arguments or a file. concepts.name: Business Impact Analysis
concepts.description: Identifies critical business functions and disruption impacts to inform recovery planning.

concepts.name: Maximum Tolerable Downtime
concepts.description: The outer interruption limit before a business function suffers unacceptable harm.

concepts.name: Mean Time to Repair / Recover
concepts.description: Average time needed to repair a failure or restore service, rather than a recovery deadline.

concepts.name: Recovery Point Objective
concepts.description: The maximum acceptable loss of data measured backward in time.

concepts.name: Recovery Time Objective
concepts.description: The target time to restore an acceptable service level after disruption.

concepts.name: Resilience and recovery in security architecture
Hardware, software, and data asset management
